Hi Colin,

Thanks for chasing this up. The September 30 date belonged to the KBOX, and that line came off your order on October 7 when we moved it across to the Magic Miner 40T, so there is nothing still sitting against that old date.

Where it stands now: your order holds the Magic Miner 40T (Batch 7) and the Harlo OS Diagnostics and 3-Month RMA pack. The 40T ships November 30, 2026, and the Harlo OS pack goes in the same box. The $1 difference from the swap went back to your original payment.

You can follow that batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

One thing on my side: the shipping paperwork for your UK leg still needs finishing at the warehouse, and I have put that in front of the team. They are offline this evening and pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET, and anything they change comes to you by email. It does not affect the November 30 date.

Your $50 code from last week, HD-••••••, is still yours to use on a future order over $200.

Any questions, just reply here.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
